records.context_quote: Target of replication The finding we will try to replicate is that reduced self-regulation resources are associated with increased biases in confirmatory information processing. The original authors demonstrated that the depletion of self-regulation resources impacts the search and the processing of standpoint-consistent information in a personnel decision case, even when confronted with an alternative explanation, i.e. the ego threat, with associated failure cognitions and negative emotions. A successful replication would find that the confirmatory information processing tendencies of participants with reduced self-regulation resources are stronger than those of nondepleted and ego threatened participants. In the original paper, both studies 2 and 4 directly test the main hypothesis.
